cap_rationale: A review proposal informed by E013 generation times; not a guaranteed completion forecast. Guard the entire new process and retain incomplete phases without retry.
decision_rules: If batch8 replay differs from saved IDs, investigate reproducibility/checkpoint integrity before interpreting a batch-size contrast.
If replay matches but batch1 differs, report batch-sensitive outputs and inspect positions/logits; this alone does not identify a causal software bug.
If failures persist at batch1, examine first-divergence margins and termination rather than silently raising the generation cap.
No successful diagnostic automatically launches training or the four-arm grid.

phases.compare: all saved generated token IDs, scores, EOS and lengths
phases.name: repeat_original_batch8

phases.compare: same prompts, weights, greedy settings and explicit masks; only batch size changes
phases.name: selected_batch1

phases.measure: reference token probability, chosen generation token probability, argmax/rank and per-row reference NLL
phases.name: reference_conditioned_logits
phases.positions: each failed row first divergence from the reference; EOS for all ten

prelaunch_requirements: complete and independently verify the checkpoint backup
implement and publish input/weight/source checks and bounded diagnostic code
validate cached and per-example decode/position/mask handling with CPU fixtures
check unchanged ledger, idle recorded A800 and pinned environment
purpose: Diagnose E013 generation reproducibility, batch sensitivity, and first-divergence token confidence before more training.
selection: Post-hoc diagnostic: all eight failed training cases plus first two successful cases by frozen train order. Not a representative new test set.
